'''Night Vision''' is a low-light visual mode that highlights terrain, structures, ships, vehicles, people, and other nearby geometry. Ships and SRVs include it as a standard function. A Commander on foot needs the Night Vision suit modification before the mode appears in the suit controls.

Night Vision is a visibility aid rather than a weapon sensor. It does not reveal objects through solid surfaces, replace radar contacts, or remove the need to identify legal and hostile targets.

== Ships and SRVs ==

Ship and SRV Night Vision requires no module or [[Engineering]]. It can be toggled through the vehicle's systems controls and is useful when:

* approaching an unlit planetary surface;
* landing on the dark side of a body;
* navigating asteroid fields or ring shadows;
* operating around dark structures and surface sites.

Frontier's Odyssey guide specifically recommends activating ship Night Vision before descending toward a settlement on the dark side of a planet.<ref name="frontier-guide">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/odyssey-guide Frontier Developments: Odyssey Guide], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== Suit modification ==

The Odyssey '''Night Vision''' modification adds a toggleable visual overlay to the Artemis Suit, [[Dominator Suit]], or Maverick Suit. It occupies one of the suit's modification slots and draws energy from the suit battery while active.<ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Night_Vision Elite Dangerous Wiki: Night Vision], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

The modification is useful for:

* moving through unpowered or damaged settlements;
* identifying doors, cover, equipment, and people in deep shadow;
* combat and salvage work on the dark side of a body;
* surface exploration when local lighting obscures terrain detail.

Night Vision can be toggled independently of the suit flashlight. It provides a broad overlay rather than a directed beam, but strong lights and bright surfaces can reduce visual clarity. Switch it off when the overlay makes a scene harder to read.

=== Engineers ===

The suit modification is available from:

* [[Oden Geiger]] in the Bubble;
* [[Yi Shen]] in Colonia.<ref name="inara-oden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/34/ INARA: Oden Geiger], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

=== Materials and credits ===

Applying Night Vision consumes:

* 5 Surveillance Equipment;
* 3 Surveillance Logs;
* 3 Radioactivity Data;
* 3 NOC Data;
* 5 Circuit Switches;
* 1,000,000 credits.<ref name="inara-oden" />

The modification is applied directly by an Engineer after the required Odyssey Engineer has been unlocked. It cannot be installed through [[Remote Engineering]].

== Selection guidance ==

Night Vision is broadly useful because darkness affects combat, salvage, missions, and exploration. Its opportunity cost is the suit-modification slot:

* an Artemis build may compare it with mobility and battery modifications;
* a Dominator build may prioritise defensive, ammunition, or weapon-handling support;
* a Maverick build may need backpack, tool-efficiency, or movement modifications first.

For suits expected to work regularly at unpowered settlements or on dark planetary surfaces, Night Vision is usually more flexible than relying entirely on the flashlight.
